name: go-echoo
description: Search, read and save your Go Echoo Super Memory notes from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Go Echoo turns what you say into text, and Super Memory keeps the notes you dictate. Connect it to ChatGPT to find a note by what is in it, read a note in full, see your latest notes, or save something from the chat as a new note. You sign in with your Go Echoo account and choose to allow access; you can disconnect at any time from your Go Echoo account page. Requires a Go Echoo account.
